name: Mingxiong Guiwu: Meigui yu Zuzhou de Zoumingqu
original_name: 冥雄鬼屋：玫瑰與詛咒的奏鳴曲
source:
At the beginning of the 20th century, you awaken in a quiet manor where everyone calls you “Anna”, a maid. But there’s one problem — you’re actually a man. Soon after, a locked-room murder occurs, and the secrets of the manor begin to unfold.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3436130]Steam[/url]]
translation:
20世纪初，你在一座安静的庄园里醒来，每个人都叫你“安娜”，一个女仆。但有一个问题——你实际上是一个男人。不久之后，发生了一起密室谋杀案，庄园的秘密开始被揭开。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3436130]Steam[/url]]
